hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas over a long stretch of residential road increases the risk for mid-block crossings.

hazards.name: Wide, straight travel lanes
hazards.description: The wide and straight road geometry may encourage vehicle speeds that are unsafe for a residential environment.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway without a mid-point refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Daylighting Obstruction
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked directly at the edge of the crosswalk, blocking the visibility of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground, white vehicle parked at the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: Despite being a school crossing zone, there are no physical speed reduction measures like speed humps or raised crossings.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are somewhat worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: A wide crossing across multiple lanes without stop signs, signals, or warning signage for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the center of the image.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to provide designated safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven sidewalk surfaces and implement a code enforcement program to ensure walkways are kept clear of debris and trash.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or other vertical deflection measures to reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions / Bulb-outs
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a buffer zone with trees or planters between the sidewalk and the curb to protect pedestrians and provide a psychological barrier from traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility midblock crosswalk

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a buffer zone with street trees or planters to separate the sidewalk from moving traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Raised Driveway Crossing
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level across the driveway to slow vehicles and reinforce pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk on the left and relocate utility poles to provide a clear, ADA-compliant path.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Install speed cushions to physically slow vehicle traffic to safer speeds within the residential zone.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfiguring the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes, which can lower speeds and provide space for other amenities.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Adding a landscaped buffer or street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Installing a high-visibility crosswalk, potentially with a refuge island, to provide a safe crossing point in this residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant surface, eliminating trip hazards.

interventions.title: Curb-side Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the street to provide physical separation and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting / Parking Restrictions
interventions.description: Implement and enforce 'No Parking' zones at least 20 feet before the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to create a physical and psychological barrier from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility ladder or continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.
